en: A black-and-white postcard showing a multi‑story villa with rows of shuttered windows and an arcade of arches on the ground floor. The foreground includes a garden with a path, low bushes, and a palm tree, framed by larger trees on the sides. At the bottom margin, printed text reads "VILLA S. IGNAZIO - TRENTO". The overall style suggests an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.
